raw_text: India's election deepfake problem is getting worse. This CM audio clip is the third confirmed AI-generated political deepfake in the current election cycle. Voice cloning tools are now cheap and accessible, requiring only minutes of sample audio. Election integrity requires urgent regulatory attention on synthetic media before it becomes impossible for voters to distinguish real from fabricated content.
